subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “The town kept lights at crossings and emergency areas while reducing unnecessary brightness.”?
options: Students visiting the town saw more stars than they had ever seen before.
From there, students saw the sea, harbor, and town together.
After residents worried about water quality, the town invited students to watch public testing.
Students visited the museum and saw the coin under bright light.
